thought: As the squad leader and first character, Ma Baoyu needs a commanding, authoritative presence that establishes him as the leader. His most distinctive feature should be immediately recognizable: exceptionally bright, intense eyes that convey his tactical intelligence and unwavering resolve. I'm pairing this with thick, dark eyebrows to create a memorable 'eagle-eyed leader' appearance. The visual style demands realistic thick-paint 2D animation with strong chiaroscuro and desaturated earth tones to match the 1941 wartime setting's harsh, solemn atmosphere.
distinctive_features: Exceptionally bright, piercing eyes with thick, dark, straight eyebrows - creating an intense, eagle-like gaze that dominates his weathered face.
prompt: Full body portrait, a Chinese male soldier in his early thirties standing in commanding military posture. Exposure: ISO 200, f/8, 1/60s. Subject: Squad leader with strikingly bright, piercing eyes beneath thick, dark, straight eyebrows that dominate his weathered, resolute face with prominent cheekbones and strong jawline. Wearing a faded grayish-green Eighth Route Army uniform jacket with standing collar, prominent brown leather military belt with metal buckle at waist, loose gray-green trousers tucked into worn cloth leg wrappings, weathered shoes. Hands relaxed at sides, shoulders back, upright stance conveying authority. Lighting: Dramatic hard directional lighting from 45-degree angle creating strong chiaroscuro contrast, deep shadows carving facial features, harsh highlight on eyes making them gleam intensely. Composition: Centered full figure, symmetrical stance, feet shoulder-width apart. Background: Solid desaturated ochre-brown, high contrast separation from figure. Depth of Field: Deep focus, f/8, entire figure razor sharp. Lens: 50mm prime lens at eye level with subtle low angle. Genre: Historical military character portrait, wartime documentation. Style: Realistic thick-paint 2D animation aesthetic with visible brushstroke texture, oil painting quality, dramatic value contrast, heavily desaturated earth palette dominated by grays, muted olive-greens, dusty browns, solemn and epic atmosphere, 1940s historical accuracy, painterly rendering.
ref_description: Soldier with intense bright eyes and thick dark eyebrows
